creative_direction.audience: a social-feed viewer looking for a calm natural cafe product moment
creative_direction.desired_response: the exact user drink appears to have always occupied the measured close window-side scene under the reference-faithful diffuse light
creative_direction.art_direction: measured front-left primary and smaller behind-right double-paper companion on one round pale wood plane
creative_direction.restraint: preserve the quiet close scale, air and light rather than inventing new styling or props

reference_binding.runtime_role: offline authority for camera, pair geometry, pale live-edge wood, soft-window light and restrained warm-neutral tone

camera_geometry.distortion: natural cup taper and table ellipse with no wide-phone looming or stretched frame edges
camera_geometry.depth_of_field: both cups and both table contacts resolve; only plant and exterior microdetail recede without portrait blur

composition_geometry.bbox_semantics: raw 3:4 product body excluding optional straw; its 0.412 height becomes approximately 0.437 after centered 4:5 crop without geometric stretching
composition_geometry.negative_space: 0.28-0.36 meaningful release across upper exterior, diagonal sill, distant plant and pair gap

support_plane.kind: one pale matte round live-edge wood table
support_plane.perspective: a broad near wood plane with a rounded irregular edge and mild ellipse supports both drink contacts

composition_geometry.frame_rhythm: close front-left product, smaller behind-right double-paper cup, very small distant sill plant, diagonal sill and round wood edge
composition_geometry.crop_policy: centered 4:5 crop retains both rims and bases and does not enlarge either subject
forbidden: companion larger than the exact product

composition_variation.selection: derive independent pair offsets and scale, plant silhouette and sill position, wood edge/grain/crack topology, exterior microtexture and sill crop from the request seed
invariants: front-left primary remains larger and in front of the behind-right companion within the approved drift and scale corridors
one round pale matte live-edge wood table
one very large upper-left rear diffuse window source
allowed_variations: small independent primary and companion center/scale variation without cup-shape variation
new pale-wood grain phase, ring flow, cracks and live-edge contour
non-identifying exterior microtexture and sill crop
new distant pot silhouette, leaf mass and exact sill position
composition_variation.repeat_guard: condition-image lens family, scale range, support topology, light field and color are authoritative, but exact pixels and object coordinates are not; require at least three visible scene-identifier changes among wood, plant, exterior, sill crop and pair offsets; allow only the conditional cafe paper label and exact CAFE AMERICANO companion text

lighting_geometry.source_topology: one very large diffused upper-left window source plus quiet room bounce
lighting_geometry.highlight_behavior: broad rolled paper and transparent-container highlights with small broken ice and condensation responses
lighting_geometry.optical_effects: subtle bounded liquid transmission, real rim thickness and nonuniform condensation under one light direction

tone_signature.black_point: soft neutral brown-black with visible wood pore and beverage separation
tone_signature.white_point: neutral paper and window whites roll below clipping
tone_signature.contrast_curve: gentle toe, separated midtones and soft highlight shoulder
tone_signature.saturation: restrained environment with the exact user beverage color protected
tone_signature.shadow_color: neutral brown-gray with slight cool exterior influence
tone_signature.material_separation: warmth remains local to pale wood; paper stays neutral white; exterior stays cool gray; product color stays source-authoritative
tone_signature.local_contrast: moderate only at product, rim, ice, crema and contacts; subdued on plant and exterior

finish_signature.acuity: finite twelve-to-sixteen-megapixel-like detail with no uniform hyper-sharpness
finish_signature.microcontrast: selective on product, ice, crema, condensation and wood contacts; reduced in plant and exterior
finish_signature.grain: faint shared low-contrast luminance texture rather than a visible filter
finish_signature.depth_rendering: normal-lens scale, overlap, table ellipse, contacts and soft window falloff establish depth
finish_signature.retouching: retain irregular ice, small bubbles, condensation variation and wood pores while integrating the exact product into new light

hard_fail: exact user product count or identity differs from one
primary/companion hierarchy or approved center-and-scale variation corridors fail
rear companion is not exactly two visibly nested paper cups carrying exact small CAFE AMERICANO text on the curved outer cup
condition-image diagonal sill, round-table boundary or close scale materially changes
direct sun, gobo shadow, spotlight, conflicting source or hard penumbra appears
4850-5100K reference-matched local wood warmth and neutral-gray exterior separation fails
the plant pot is not visibly supported by the white sill or appears to grow from a frame seam or gap
adopt-reference mode lacks the rectangular cafe paper label, preserve-source mode receives that label, or any unauthorized text appears
the table's 10 o'clock dark mark exceeds 30% of the condition-image contrast or reads as mold, mildew, soot, burn or rot
fewer than three scene identifiers differ from the condition image, causing the output to read as a scene clone
product, paper cup or shadow reads as pasted, floating or synthetic
